title: A finite type algebra over a field in which every prime is maximal is finite-dimensional
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $B$ be a commutative $k$-algebra of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] (the zero ring is allowed) in which every prime ideal is a maximal ideal, i.e. $\dim B\le0$. Then $B$ is a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space: $\dim_kB<\infty$.
